phase10_grid.description: The full 52-experiment Phase 10 grid (13 feature sets x 4 models) is treated as a SINGLE locked comparison family. No post-hoc exclusion of inconvenient experiments is permitted.
phase10_grid.rationale: Phase 10 is an ablation study over a pre-registered grid. All 52 experiments belong to the same researcher search space. Treating them as a single family is the conservative choice.

iid_bootstrap.assumptions: observations are independent and identically distributed
iid_bootstrap.description: Ordinary bootstrap; valid only for i.i.d. observations

moving_block_bootstrap.assumptions: stationary time series with short-range dependence
moving_block_bootstrap.description: Moving block bootstrap with deterministic block length

known_limitations: Inference is on a 20-symbol development universe; generalization to larger universes is not tested.
Block length is set by rule of thumb, not optimized against outcomes.
The label (5-session forward return) creates overlapping outcomes; dependence diagnostics will disclose this.
Backtest metrics inherit all backtester assumptions (costs, execution, sizing).
Bootstrap CIs are approximate; they do not provide exact finite-sample coverage.
The inference layer analyzes evidence; it does not generate new signals or strategies.

phase10.description: Phase 10 feature ablation grid (13 feature sets x 4 models = 52)

statistical_vs_economic_separation: Every result must separately report: (1) statistical evidence, (2) effect magnitude, (3) uncertainty bounds, and (4) economic interpretation. Statistical significance is NEVER treated as equivalent to deployable trading edge.
